source.method: built-in image generation followed by deterministic crop, point downsample, 16-colour reduction and alpha cleanup
source.prompt_summary: four top-down V-shaped military prop-wash phases; transparent; late-1990s pre-rendered pixel source; muted steel-blue and off-white; no ship, text, glow or modern particles

runtime.palette_guidance: muted blue-gray water shadow, steel-blue turbulence, restrained off-white foam

visual_contract.read: propeller-driven displacement and speed without hiding the hull silhouette
reject: photorealistic wake pasted into pixel art
